info.title: FIRE-EYE Disaster Response Engine
info.description: FIRE-EYE Inclusive & Fault-Tolerant Disaster Response System API

post.description: Register a new user (Citizen, Rescue Responder, Volunteer, or Admin).
Authenticate with username and password, returning JWT access and refresh tokens.
Issue a new access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Retrieve authenticated user's profile and assigned role.

schema.title: Response Get Risk Zones Api V1 Disaster Zones Get

get.description: Retrieve list of registered vulnerable households, with optional zone and vulnerability filters.

schema.title: Response Get Households Api V1 Households  Get

post.description: Register a new household record with computed vulnerability scoring.

get.description: Retrieve details for a single household by its code.

post.description:
Create an Emergency SOS request.
Idempotent: If an SOS with the same idempotency_key already exists, returns the existing record.

get.description: Retrieve all unresolved active SOS requests sorted by priority.

schema.title: Response Get Active Sos Api V1 Sos Active Get

get.description: Retrieve all SOS requests initiated by the current authenticated citizen.

schema.title: Response Get My Sos Requests Api V1 Sos My Get

get.description: Retrieve details for a single SOS request.

patch.description:
Update the triage or rescue operational status of an SOS request.
Allowed statuses: PENDING, ASSIGNED, DISPATCHED, RESCUED, CANCELLED.

post.description: Assign a rescue team or responder to an active SOS request.
Receive store-and-forward mesh packet representing an offline SOS.

get.description: Retrieve all emergency shelters with live capacity and availability.

schema.title: Response Get Shelters Api V1 Shelters  Get

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific shelter.

patch.description: Update shelter occupancy, operational status, or safety condition.

post.description:
Ingest a store-and-forward mesh packet submitted by a hardware gateway node.
Performs deduplication, updates message log, and enqueues SOS when appropriate.

get.description: List recent ingested mesh packets and store-and-forward history.
Retrieve system audit trail records (Admin / Oversight).

schema.title: Response Get Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get
